Class SpatialFalsificationMetrics

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.analytics.SpatialFalsificationMetrics
public final class SpatialFalsificationMetrics extends Object

SpatialFalsificationMetrics

Mathematical utility suite providing spatial statistical metrics for falsification and sensitivity benchmarks across windowed sub-grids and full planetary spheres.

Implements:

  • Spatial Pearson correlation coefficient \(r\).
  • Mean Absolute Percentage Error (\(\text{MAPE}\)) on common core spatial cells.
  • Demographic centroid center-of-mass shift \(\Delta R\) (km) via Great-Circle Haversine distance.
  • Boundary reflection index \(I_{\mathrm{refl}}\) evaluating boundary-to-core demographic ratios.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
